main_text.p: עָרַם Hebr. Calliditate, Astu usus fuit. Hinc Ch. in Ithpehal מִתְעָרִים Astutus fiet, Prov.19.25.
עָרִימָא, עָרִימָאי, עָרִים Ch. Astutus, callidus. Plur. constr. עָרִימֵאי Prov.14.18.
עֲרִימְתָא, עֲרִימָא Chald. Acervus, cumulus. Plur. עֲרִימָן, עֲרִימְתָא.
עוּרְמָא Ch. Idem. Plur. עוּרְמָן, Exo.15.8. in Jon.
ܥܪܡܐ Syr. Idem: ܥܪܡܐ ܥܪܡܬܐ ܥܪܡܢ Et erit tumulus, humilis, Lucæ 3.5.

עָרֵם עַרְסָא, עַרְסָא Ch. & Syr. Lectus, Sponda lecti: Itē Feretrum, lectus mortui, 2.Sam.3.31. & sic Syr. Luc.7.14. Plur.fœmin. עַרְסָן, & ex forma masc. עַרְסִין Thren.2.21. cum affix. עַרְסִיהוֹן Amos 6.4.
עַרְסְלָא עַרְסַל Ch. Lectulus, cubile vagum, quod de loco in locum movetur, Jesa.1.8. & 24.20. ubi per ɾ scribitur.

עַרַע Ch. Accidere, incidere, offendere, contingere, obviam venire, occurrere, incurrere, evenire. Pahel עָרַע Idem: Item Convocare, indicare, coetum, conventum aut diem festivum: Item Pertingere, contingere, attingere. Ithpahel אִתְעָרַע Obviam fieri, occurrere, incidere.
עַרְעִיתָא Chald. Idem, Eccles.9.11. Item Crabro, Hebr. צִרְעָה, mutato ɾ in ɣ.
מַעֲרָעָא, מַעֲרַע Ch. Convocatio, coetus, conventus solennis.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are printed in their own script and are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; some vowel points and small letters are uncertain and may differ from the printed form. The Syriac line and several Hebrew headwords are approximate.
